title: Delete-for-all must clear body and attachments
description: draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00 §Message deletedAt: when set, body is empty and attachments is empty. crate-jmap-chat-server/src/message.rs deletedForAll branch (~line 738) injects deletedAt and (after JMAP-mrod.3) clears editHistory, but leaves body and attachments as stored, so a deleted-for-all Message still returns its content. Found while fixing JMAP-mrod.3; left out of scope.
